title: Drag and dropping task to another virtual desktop inside pager sometimes briefly flickers back before moving
line: A window dropped onto another desktop in the Pager no longer flashes back on its old desktop before moving.
explanation: The Pager dragged the window outline itself, reparenting it out of its desktop. On release it hid the outline, asked KWin to move the window and immediately reset the whole model, which recreated the outline on its old desktop; until KWin's desktop change arrived (a frame or two) the outline showed there again. The change drags a separate stand-in rectangle and only hides the real outline meanwhile, so the model is never reset; after a drop the stand-in stays where it was dropped until the outline leaves its old desktop (or 1 s passes if the window doesn't move).

commits.message:
applets/pager: Drag a stand-in instead of the window outline itself

Dragging reparented the outline and every release reset the model, so a
dropped outline flashed back on its old desktop until KWin moved it.
Drag a separate rectangle that stays where it was dropped until then.

BUG: 524124

media.caption: Pager frames right after dropping the outline from desktop 3 onto desktop 1: in the 4th frame it is back on desktop 3 and desktop 1 is empty.
Same drop with the fix: the outline stays on desktop 1 in every frame.
10 drags between desktops 1 and 3: each drop onto desktop 1 flashes the outline back on desktop 3 (5 of 10 drops).
Same 10 drags with the fix: no flash.

review.text: Dragging a separate stand-in Rectangle instead of reparenting the real window outline and calling pagerModel.refresh() is the right architectural fix and completely eliminates the flicker back to the source desktop, as shown clearly in the frame strips and videos. However, windowMouseArea does not handle onCanceled: if an active drag is canceled (for example by losing the pointer grab or hiding the panel), onReleased never runs, leaving dragProxy stuck visibly on screen and the real window outline permanently hidden at opacity 0. Additionally, onPressed mutates dragProxy's geometry and colors unconditionally even if dragProxy is still visible waiting on dropTimeout from a previous drop.
changes: Add an onCanceled handler to windowMouseArea that clears `dragProxy.source = null` when `dragProxy.source === windowRect` so a canceled drag does not leave the stand-in stuck and the real outline invisible.

Avoid overwriting dragProxy geometry/colors in onPressed while a previous drop's stand-in is still pending (e.g. clear any stale post-drop dragProxy.source and stop dropTimeout before initializing, or initialize dragProxy only once drag.active becomes true after recording the press geometry).

reviews.text: Right root cause: master reparented the real outline and called pagerModel.refresh() on every release, so the old-desktop delegate was rebuilt before KWin's desktop change arrived. Dragging a stand-in and keeping it until the source delegate is destroyed (the Item property nulls itself) removes the flash without a model reset, and the frame strips and 10-drop videos show it clearly. Skipping moveWindow for same-desktop drops and windows on all desktops matches what moveWindow already did on master. Minor nit: with the non-default 'show window icons' option the stand-in carries no icon while dragging, and in the activity pager a drop onto an activity the window already has leaves the stand-in up for the 1 s timeout.
